newsitem.title: UK: Dated Brent weakens to trade at March Brent-10 cts.
newsitem.headline: Dated Brent weakens to trade at March Brent-10 cts.

text.p: Dated Brent weakened on Thursday, losing its premium to forward paper as end February demand remained slack and the arbitrage to the United States shut, traders said.
A cargo due to load Feb 25-27 was sold for March Brent -10 cents to a European major. A Feb 26-28 cargo traded at March Brent +5 cents on Wednesday, they said.
At least two other late February cargoes were still thought to be available. The first March cargoes are due to be nominated loading dates on Friday.
